install: set -eu; [ -n "${BASH_VERSION:-}" ] && set -o pipefail; touch "$HOME/.bashrc"; sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || true; if ! command -v cargo >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ ! -x "$HOME/.cargo/bin/cargo" ]; then curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -fsSL https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y --no-modify-path --default-toolchain stable; fi; if [ -d "$HOME/.cargo/bin" ]; then grep -qxF 'export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH"' "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH"; fi; if ! command -v elan >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ ! -x "$HOME/.elan/bin/elan" ]; then curl -fsSL https://elan.lean-lang.org/elan-init.sh | sh -s -- -y --no-modify-path --default-toolchain "$(tr -d '[:space:]' < spec/lean-toolchain)"; fi; if [ -d "$HOME/.elan/bin" ]; then grep -qxF 'export PATH="$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH"' "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; export PATH="$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH"; fi; (cd spec && lake build); cargo check --workspace --all-targets
